title: $p^*$ preserves the unit
statement:
Give $\Sh(*_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ and $\Sh((\Spec\Z)_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$
the tensor products of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor], whose units are the
constant sheaves $\Z$. The functor $p_*$ is lax monoidal. By the adjunction
[def-sfb-point-adjunction], $p^*$ is therefore oplax monoidal. Its unit
comparison morphism $p^*\Z\to\Z$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The canonical pushforward is lax monoidal and the point adjunction transfers this structure to the oplax pullback as in [lem-sfb-monoidal-adjunction-mates]. Unfold pointUpperStar to the concrete sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback of [def-sfb-point-upper-star]. By [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-finite-limits], its site functor is representably flat, hence all the opposite comma categories are filtered and in particular connected. Continuity is [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-continuous]. Apply the unit clause of [lem-sfb-general-sheaf-pullback-monoidal-comparisons] with A = Ab. All sheafification, monoidal and Kan-extension instances are the existing instances of these sites. This is the actual oplax unit comparison of pointUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction, since both its oplax structure and the generic one are defined by the same leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal construction.
